paged_attention_decode: run paged attention decoding with a KV cache, block tables, and softmax scale on CUDA
paged_attention_flashinfer: run paged attention decoding using flashinfer with logits soft cap and KV scaling
paged_attention_flashdecoding: run paged attention decoding using flashdecoding with variable length forward pass and windowing
attention_prefill: run flash attention prefill with query, key, value tensors and a KV cache on CUDA
attention_flashinfer_prefill: run flash attention prefill using flashinfer with causal masking and paged KV cache
